capabilities: search the vault for notes whose titles include words from the active note
append links to related notes in the active note
filter search terms by minimum character count and ignored words
exclude a configured folder such as daily notes from the search
extras: The README references a GIF example that was removed from the extracted text, so the visual demonstration is not visible here.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in command that finds notes related by shared title words and suggests links to them while writing.
summary: Link suggestion plugin that searches the vault for notes whose titles contain words from the active note and can append links to them.
